title: How to reset your password
content: Open the sign-in page and choose Forgot password. Enter your work email and we send a reset link that stays valid for 30 minutes. If the email does not arrive, check your spam folder and ask your IT team to allow mail from the platform's no-reply address. You can request a new link at any time; only the newest link works.

title: Account locked after too many failed logins
content: After five wrong passwords the account locks for 15 minutes to protect it. Wait for the timer to finish and sign in again, or ask an administrator to unlock the account immediately from Users, then Unlock. Resetting your password also clears the lock.

title: Two-factor authentication: setup and lost devices
content: Turn on two-factor authentication under Profile, then Security, and scan the QR code with an authenticator app. Save your ten recovery codes somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, sign in with a recovery code and register the new device. If you have no codes left, an administrator can reset your two-factor setup after verifying your identity.

title: Understanding your invoice and billing cycle
content: Invoices are issued on the first day of each month for the plan you were on during the previous month. Each invoice lists the plan, extra seats and taxes. You can download PDF invoices under Billing, then Invoices, and add your company name and GST or tax number under Billing details so it appears on future invoices.

title: Refunds and duplicate charges
content: If you were charged twice for the same period, the duplicate is refunded in full. Refunds go back to the original payment method and take 5 to 7 business days to appear. Contact support with the invoice number and the last four digits of the card. Charges older than 60 days cannot be refunded.

title: Fixing error 500 and blank pages
content: A 500 error or a blank page usually means a temporary server problem or a stale browser cache. Refresh the page, then clear the browser cache or try a private window. If the error continues, note the time, the page address and any error id shown, and send them to support so engineers can find the matching log entry. Check the status page for known incidents first.

title: Exporting reports to CSV or Excel
content: Open the report you need, set the date range and filters, then choose Export in the top right corner and pick CSV or Excel. Large exports over 50,000 rows are prepared in the background and emailed to you as a download link. Dashboard tiles use the same data as the export, so differences usually come from a different date range or filter.

title: API keys, authentication and rate limits
content: Create an API key under Settings, then API access, and send it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. A 401 response means the key is missing, expired or copied with extra spaces; create a fresh key if in doubt. The API allows 100 requests per minute per key and returns 429 when you go over, so retry after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header.

title: Troubleshooting a missing SFTP file feed
content: Scheduled files are delivered to your SFTP folder every night at 02:00 UTC. If a file did not arrive, confirm the schedule is enabled, check that your SFTP credentials have not expired and that the folder has free space. You can re-run the feed from Integrations, then Schedules, then Run now. Passwords for SFTP users expire every 90 days.

title: Configuring single sign-on with your identity provider
content: Single sign-on needs the platform's entity id and reply URL in your identity provider and the provider's metadata file uploaded under Settings, then Security, then SSO. A sign-in loop usually means the reply URL does not match exactly or the user's email in the identity provider differs from the email in the platform. Test with one pilot user before turning SSO on for everyone.
